info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Update Customer Offer Sale API enables authorized users to modify existing sales offers for customers based on a specific parameter. This operation allows businesses to adapt pricing, promotions, or terms efficiently, ensuring that the sales offerings remain competitive and relevant. Typical consumers of this API include sales teams and marketing analysts who need to tailor offers to customer preferences or market conditions. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can enhance customer satisfaction and improve sales performance.
